traceability.notes:
Based on the implementation and tests, story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG is fully implemented.
All key requirements are met with concrete evidence: - Recommended and strict presets are implemented as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays in src/index.ts and are intended to be spread after a `plugins` registration object (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG). Tests using FlatESLint confirm they enable traceability rules as documented. - The plugin and the repository’s own eslint.config.js follow ESLint v9 flat-config best practices, and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provides extensive guidance and examples for JS-only, TS-only, mixed, and monorepo projects (REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION, User Experience, Documentation acceptance criteria). - Customization of story locations and patterns is supported via valid-story-reference (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) and valid-annotation-format’s configurable regex patterns and examples, with behavior validated by unit tests (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, REQ-RULE-OPTIONS). - Configuration validation and error handling for invalid options are implemented via JSON Schema (additionalProperties: false) on relevant rules and via dedicated error reporting for invalid regex-based options in valid-annotation-format, with detailed tests verifying messages and fallback behavior (REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION and the Error Handling acceptance criterion). - Multiple Jest test suites are explicitly tied to this story via @story annotations and requirement IDs; all such tests pass in the current test run.
There is no concrete evidence of any unmet functional requirement from this story, so the assessment is PASSED.
